regenerate_command: scripts/generate-perf-target-manifest.sh --repo-url https://github.com/rust-lang/rust.git --ref main --name rust --conflict-merge-ref stable --conflict-path Cargo.lock --diff-path Cargo.lock
notes: mid_merge_conflict_list_and_open uses a synthetic fixture branch 'perf-conflict-cargo' (generated by the script from merge-base(pinned, stable) with Cargo.lock version-bumped) because real rust branches (stable/beta) do not conflict on Cargo.lock when merged into main. The fixture guarantees a real Cargo.lock content conflict while keeping the scenario's merge a fast single-file working-tree write.
